description: This file implements the DownloadManagerHttpClient class, which handles HTTP file downloads using libcurl. It includes methods for initializing curl, performing downloads with rate limiting, handling progress updates, and cleanup.

classes.name: DownloadManagerHttpClient
classes.description: Class responsible for handling HTTP file downloads, managing curl sessions, concurrency, and progress reporting.

methods.name: DownloadManagerHttpClient()
methods.description: Constructor initializes the curl handle and prepares the object.

methods.name: ~DownloadManagerHttpClient()
methods.description: Destructor cleans up curl resources and associated mutex.

methods.name: DownloadManagerHttpClient::Status downloadFile(const std::string & url,const std::string & fileName,uint32_t rateLimit)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP download of a specified URL to a local file with optional rate limiting, returning the status of the operation.

methods.name: size_t progressCb(void * ptr,double dltotal,double dlnow,double ultotal,double ulnow)
methods.description: Callback function for curl to report download progress; updates the progress percentage and handles cancellation.

methods.name: size_t write_data(void * ptr,size_t size,size_t nmemb,FILE * stream)
methods.description: Callback function for curl to write incoming data to a file stream.
